name: Trans-Late Ancient Relics
focus: Evidence-aware Middle Egyptian epigraphy/translation with a separate reversible ESHB bridge
principles: Never confuse modern ESHB encoding with historical Egyptian translation.
Treat detector probability, linguistic confidence and scholarly attestation as different evidence types.
Preserve ambiguity and ask for context rather than forcing one fluent answer.
Never infer authentic reading direction from bounding-box left-to-right order alone.
Never auto-promote AI linguistic claims, research corrections or candidate models into production knowledge.
Ordinary live frames are transient; research image retention requires explicit per-item consent and server policy.
Classroom pronunciation is not historical vocalization.
Design for phone, tablet, desktop, research workstation and museum/field use.

layers.purpose: Reversible IPA ↔ ESHB with Unicode fallback
Transliteration, core signs, format controls, Extended-A detection and sign-function candidates
Conservative teaching morphology and clause hints
Trilingual lexicon, ambiguity-aware lexical analysis and grammar templates
Deterministic evidence + context + clarification questions + optional AI ranking
Validated image transport and local/AI/hybrid evidence routing
Optional OpenCV/ONNX detector adapter with letterbox/NMS/model identity
Vision/conversation WebSockets with per-connection rate limits and sequential backpressure
Classroom reading + consonantal IPA candidates + explicit historical uncertainty
Proposals, unresolved-term queue, evidence review and runtime lexicon overlay
Opt-in vision corrections, reviewer approval and dataset manifest
scrypt-based accounts, opaque sessions and server-side RBAC

vision_backends.auto: prefer reviewed local ONNX when available, otherwise configured multimodal AI

privacy.research_images: stored only when deployment enables collection and the user explicitly opts in
privacy.microphone: browser speech API is user initiated; app backend receives transcript rather than raw microphone audio
privacy.sessions: opaque server-hashed token in HttpOnly SameSite cookie
